Been abt 2️⃣ years since my season of Fiovivor aired, a time i feel like atleast half of you weren't present for 😵‍💫 🪦 😮‍💨
So to give a "teensy" lil recap: fio recruits me out of the blue, impeccable timing tbh cuz i had quit a diff place to focus on a trip to my siblings, & pekka would start after i get back home. Hindsight (aka kongvivor barrel blast) taught me i dEFO coulda played an org at a diff place from home, so Fio got rlly lucky there
I was crushing it socially, part of the majority alliance, but AJ pulled the "ghosts for a day then tries to talk game" strat, it rlly pissed me, hey everyone lets vote off aj!
Except, Sadie was all "no, we HAVE to vote off FortniteFred2005" & she proceeded to go. Made a parchment for the occasion actually
but idt it saw light of day cuz that tribal pissed me off so bad, & i thought emp was a likeable enough lad, i said fuck it & mutinied spur of the moment
So im very emotional
Nearly went out pre-merge, it took a hasty lie abt kenny targeting lindsey, lindsey prob not believing me but not giving a fuck, & lindsey wanting to make a #BigMove to survive THAT ONE 💀
i remember Srag hating on all of me/marissa/lukas for conduct after that vote, even if i think most of the criticism was on Lukas
Anyways guess who got blindsided & was thrusted into minority ?!?!?!?!?!?! With my obvious ass quartet who formed from blindsiding Kenny & all, had to quickly pivot & show off adaptability. Went to Emp/Georgia briefly, before ditching THEM to commit to xsoul/sasha
Pissed off jurors along the way with my gameplay, ppl either thought i did jackshit or outright hated the snakery at display (hence why im a villain & on the villains tribe)
reallllll funny of the hosts to put Marionette on the same tribe as me, the ONLY OTHER SZN REP I GOT, when she was one of my most vocal haters
I remember Fio saying Pekka alumni are an elusive bunch, but only 2️⃣ of us? Virgo already call my szn "the flop one" bc of shallow rep, but we were SOLId, we were GOOd
Saw dallas ask who we were surprised didnt make the cut, tbh my answer would be xSoul or Sasha (tho i'd only guess sasha bc of their in-server activity. before i joined this server i thought "no fucking way"). Or Emp, i miss him
marionette atleast seemed chill with me in marooning chat, tho i remember having a lot of frustrations with her. This was how she interacted with me during the F12-F9 part of the game:

- Talk abt how we're gonna lock in & work together
- She ghosts me for a good amount of time
- Animal Crossing chit-chat cuz it was the only thing I knew she liked that i could reasonably talk abt

rinse & repeat until she felt like blindsiding Sadie
but even after THAT i never considered her an ally, the bridge was too far burned at that point. Emp/Georgia/xSoul/Sasha all put their money in their mouths, marionette didnt. So im coming in here with a negative bias against her
I've met other ppl thru other means however, may we not forget Brent's whole ass introduction WAS FOCUSEd ON CEPHALORG ☠️
fucker hasn't payed for a therapist btw, i still need that from him
but being on the same tribe as him again, ik he's gonna attempt a power play. kinda fear it'll be me? Our relationship's kinda rocky, I don't have much faith in working with him
tho atp, ive only made like, 2️⃣ allies kfhgksfhgsk neptune & virgo
virgo ill shove in here but he seems pretty nice! Not sure if he sucks on text yet but I'll find out soon, liked him on voice. He called us Final 2️⃣, & ykw sure, fuck yeah we are 😎
the other person was Neptune, who's actually another person I played with before, which might be the most random pairing of ppl who've played together. On a HvV type season no less

This sounds like marriage

I'm not sure if the confs prior really show my thought process for that vote, I was instead off doing my own thing, chiming in every now & then specifically in tribal chat, & not rlly here

But there was something else i was considering, that I was frankly fearing...
.
.
.
The idol. It was out there still

I'm thinking Woofley has it; Katie mentioned finding the previous one to me/kyle, so surely six chungus would tell each other if we found the idol. It was my own personal plan if I had found it.

Alright then, let's keep my vote onto Woofley, since she's a clear enemy, who's most likely to own this idol. Everyone clearly thinks im voting that way, but during the vote reading & advantage call, Katie comes to my dm's, looking for comfort

Eventually, Cristen mentions the convo we had earlier today; I mentioned wanting to deal with the idol as a priority, & ultimately we had clashing views on who could hold the idol
I thought it was Woofley, she thought it was Cristen. Both sides were making their pitches, & it seemed like this Cristen/Virgo/Woofley Final 3️⃣ was possible
Virgo eventually asks us to vote early cuz we're arguing in circles, we won't be able to get new developments going, why waste time? Hearing his pleas, & getting a ping from my submissions, I send in a Woofley vote
Seemed like losing an easy beat in Cristen/Virgo would be worth it if it meant them not brute forcing Final 3️⃣.
3️⃣ votes are ultimately in, we're waiting for one more person: Cristen. Her work meant she couldnt sit down & vote right away, she needs 20 minutes. Virgo decides now is the time to take a shower.
Virgo also wasted an Ender Pearl on himself, he coulda gotten Katie out 3-2 & avoid this entire tie if he felt bold.
Timing & the idol would keep being brought up as convo points, both of which being my main mantras for this round, knowing when I had to dive the dagger into Katie/Kyle. Voting them out now was wayyyy too risky, wasn't it? Cuz cristen/virgo want Woofley at final tribal, not me

& atp, the threat of losing cristen/virgo was becoming increasingly larger, & forcing rocks just because they didnt want woofley out was haphazard, dangerous, & any synonym to the word "dumb"

She got greedy

when before it was an either/or spot between her & woofley. Unfortunately I couldn't get Virgo's affirmation on the future, i even joined the vc to try & lure him in, since he WANTS me to vc with him, atleast for the fights

I had to hear her pleas to stay directly
"If Kyle got rocked out im idoling you" but rocks is almost a complete crapshoot with 3️⃣ ppl participating, i cant lose cristen/virgo like that, cuz if they do go out, you're idoling either urself or kyle
She mentioned the promise I made to her earlier, & the time she saved me with Immunity at the Enya tribal. The promise wasn't kept, & that's on me for agreeing to it in the first place. But the Enya vote showed me why i COULdNT sit with her, why i COULdNT keep her around 1️⃣ more vote
& then she said she was never voting for me. "Not out of bitterness", but because voting her out was just that bad. Kyle assisted in that narrative
